cohort: Women between 15 and 49 years of age from the 2015-2017 Peruvian Demographic and Family Health Survey (ENDES) database
finding: The prevalence of cesarean section found in the present study was above the value recommended by the WHO (10%) for both public and private facilities.
mod_finding: The prevalence of cesarean section was significantly higher in private health facilities compared to public health facilities.
